sentences.text: This is Vowed. You type any goal in your own words, put a small stake behind it, and prove it each day with your phone.
Everything here runs on Solana devnet, with test tokens that have no value.
Your Solana wallet is your account. Vowed first shows how to switch Phantom to its practice network.
Then it asks once, through the Mobile Wallet Adapter: Phantom asks me to connect, and to sign one message that proves the wallet is mine.
No funds move, and there is no password.
I claim free test tokens: twenty test USDC and twenty test SKR, sent on devnet.
Now a goal. I type: do twenty squats every day for a week.
Vowed turns the words into a plan, and says how the goal will be proved. Here the camera counts the reps, so the plan is marked high trust.
I keep it as a demo pool, where a day lasts two minutes, and I stake one test USDC.
Before anything is signed, Vowed decodes the transaction on the phone and checks every address.
It shows what I pay in devnet SOL: the network fee, the account rent, and the total.
One approval in Phantom covers creating the pool and staking in it.
The stake is now held by the program on Solana, and the challenge page counts down to the moment check-ins open.
Check-in time. For this goal, the proof is the camera.
It maps my body on the phone and coaches me into frame. Then it counts the squats as I do them: one, two, three.
The picture is analysed on the phone and never leaves it. Only the number of reps is sent.
The day is recorded, and the streak is written to Solana.
Not every goal needs a camera. For less than thirty minutes a day on Instagram, Vowed proposes the phone's own usage data instead.
In Explore, public challenges can be filtered by kind and by token. The ones marked sample are example data.
Joining one works the same way: a review with the costs, one approval in Phantom, and Vowed confirms it on Solana.
Squads are for friends. I create one, and get an invite code to share and a leaderboard for the group.
The You screen holds the rest: a coach, test SKR rewards and streak freezes, letters to my future self, and a home screen widget.
Vowed. Put something on the line for your goals.
